name: Japanese sliding door (shoji)
style: low-poly game prop (herio 2021); Textures.com photo textures dropped, flat colours

source.author: herio
source.note: Wave-1 row 145 named a Quaternius Japanese door (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge). This is the paper sliding door from herio's CC-BY 4.0 Japanese school wall kit on OpenGameArt: only the `door` object of school.blend is kept. It is a Japanese school-classroom sliding door: a wooden frame with a solid lower panel, six recessed paper panes in a 2x3 lattice and a finger-pull groove, not a fine kumiko shoji grid. The source is 0.85 x 1.49 m; it is scaled to a real 1.8 m door height (1.03 m wide). Front faces +Z, bottom on y = 0. Static, no clips. The source's Textures.com photo textures are only sampled for flat colours and are not shipped (the GLB has no images).
source.changes: kept only the `door` object of school.blend (walls, floor, roof and column removed); scaled from 1.49 m to a real 1.8 m door height; photo textures removed and replaced by flat cel colours; normalized, recompressed.
